text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean in bins of 0.1 clear-sky index, for three groups of valid hours. If clipping drove the over- correction, the hours around solar noon (11-13 UTC) would sit above the others in the sunniest bins. Five Primary substations, June to August, valid 09:00 to 15:00 UTC, 1 to 4 days ahead, forecasts from experiment 46.'
